hooks.command: if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi

statusLine.command: jq -r 'def yellow: "\u001b[33m" + . + "\u001b[0m"; def human: if . == null then "--" elif . >= 1000000 then ((. / 1000000 * 10 | round) / 10 | tostring) + "m" elif . >= 1000 then ((. / 1000 * 10 | round) / 10 | tostring) + "k" else tostring end; .rate_limits as $r | .context_window as $c | ($c.context_window_size | human | yellow) as $size | (if $c.current_usage == null then "Context: \("--" | yellow) / \($size)" else $c.current_usage as $u | (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) | human | yellow) as $used | "Context: \($used) / \($size)" end) as $context | [$context, ($r.five_hour.used_percentage | select(. != null) | "5h: \((round | tostring) + "%" | yellow)"), ($r.seven_day.used_percentage | select(. != null) | "7d: \((round | tostring) + "%" | yellow)")] | join(" | ")'
